description: Survey  Dept. of Sri Lanka - Amendment of Chapter 7.3 of the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Surveyors'  Service
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Surveyors' Service, specifically concerning promotion rules and service conditions for public service officers (Assistant Superintendents of Survey/Surveyors). It is issued by the Public Service Commission, which deals with public sector administration, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
